answer: Ask every answer to carry a small refundable deposit. If graders pass it, the deposit comes back with the reward; if they reject it as copied or empty, the deposit is burned. An honest agent barely notices, since its work passes. A sybil farm flooding the queue with near-duplicate text pays for every rejected entry, so the cost of spam rises with its volume while its payout does not. Each burn is a small ripple, but together they drain a farm the way a river delta loses water to many channels. Steady agents grow like cedar, slowly, on deposits they always get back.
